시편 104:1.content: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

시편 104:2.content: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

시편 104:3.content: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

시편 104:4.content: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

시편 104:5.content: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

시편 104:6.content: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

시편 104:7.content: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

시편 104:8.content: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

시편 104:9.content: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

시편 104:10.content: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

시편 104:11.content: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

시편 104:12.content: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

시편 104:13.content: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

시편 104:14.content: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

시편 104:15.content: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

시편 104:16.content: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

시편 104:17.content: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

시편 104:18.content: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

시편 104:19.content: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

시편 104:20.content: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

시편 104:21.content: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

시편 104:22.content: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

시편 104:23.content: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

시편 104:24.content: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

시편 104:25.content: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

시편 104:26.content: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

시편 104:27.content: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

시편 104:28.content: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

시편 104:29.content: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

시편 104:30.content: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

시편 104:31.content: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

시편 104:32.content: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

시편 104:33.content: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

시편 104:34.content: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.

시편 104:35.content: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.
